releaseName: One pause switch for model calls, one request id, and the operator's run trace
summary: The operator can pause every model call at once: refused requests answer that the service is paused for a short while, and new briefs are saved without reading the job ad. Each request carries one id from the browser through the API and the run queue to the worker's log lines and run spans. The operator can read a member's run trace by organisation and run id, content-free and written to the audit log. Deleting or exporting records in a shared organisation needs a second factor, and sensitive actions write an audit line kept 400 days. A job page fetch that times out is tried once more before the brief is refused.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. The run dialog can still offer Start when the day's runs are used (#3126). Deleting an account from the screen works only for a person alone in their organisation; a team owner asks an operator. The readable copy does not yet include the career interview or research briefs.
